content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIIT Nagpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIIT Nagpur Project Associate-I (PA-I) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate-I (PA-I): Master degree (M.Sc. / M. Tech) in Physics or equivalent with first class (minimum aggregate percentage 60% with 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD). Qualified in any National eligibility test/exam: GATE, CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship, or National-level examination conducted by Central Govt. Departments and agencies (DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc.).

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Associate-I (PA-I): No specific age limit mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Associate-I (PA-I): Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA (Through NET/GATE/National Level Exam) or Rs. 30,000 + 20% HRA (Otherwise)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on merit, academic performance, and project relevance Interview for shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIIT Nagpur Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Nagpur (IIIT Nagpur) for their project titled 'ANRF PAIR IITB HUB'.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IIIT Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position advertised is Project Associate-I (PA-I) under the advertisement number IIITN/ANRF-PAIR/Manpower/2026/04.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I (PA-I) post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master degree (M.Sc. / M. Tech) in Physics or equivalent with first class along with a National eligibility test/exam like GATE, CSIR-UGC NET, etc.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA for candidates who qualified through a National Eligibility Test/GATE/National Level Exam, and Rs. 30,000 + 20% HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIIT Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Candidates need to send their filled applications and documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to IIIT Nagpur?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official recruitment notification released by IIIT Nagpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on merit, academic performance, and project relevance, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of IIIT Nagpur at www.iiitn.ac.in to download the prescribed application format and check further details.
